title: LimitedSpectator
description: A survival-friendly spectator mode with configurable limits.
body:
# Limited Spectator
A survival friendly spectator/freecam plugin that allows users to take screenshots from the air.

- Limited to a 30 block radius (configurable)
- Anti x-ray (configurable)
- Saves original position
- Multiple usages:
  - /s
  - /spectator
  - /spec
  - /freecam
 
Tested on **paper 1.21.11**, may not work on other versions/loaders.
